body.message:
Hi, I’d like to understand the situation clearly. During the previous months, you always contacted me and informed me that I should move out on the last day of the month. However, this month I did not receive any message or notice from you regarding moving out.

So, could you please clarify why I am being contacted today and being asked to move out today, even though today is not the last day of the month?

Also, I would like to know exactly what the contract says regarding the move-out date and on what basis today has been determined as my last day.

I would appreciate a clear explanation of the reason and the procedure I am expected to follow. Thank you.
